provenance.source_snippet: Tenders shall be opened on 24 August 2026 at 17:00 Hours in the presence of the tenderers at the Office of Dy. Superintending Engineer, IIT (ISM) Dhanbad, who may be present.
The bidder should make a note of the unique Tender ID assigned to each tender; in case they want to obtain any clarification / help from the Helpdesk.

The tender form must be filled and all entries must be made by the handwritten in ink. All the rates must be filled both in words and figures. If any of the documents is missing or un-signed, the tender will be considered invalid. All erasers and alterations made while filling the tender must be attested by dated initials of the tenderers. Overwriting of the figures is not permitted.
Bidders are required to enroll on the e-Procurement module of the Central Public Procurement Portal (URL:http://eprocure.gov.in/eprocure/app) by clicking on the link "Click here to Enroll".
The bidder should make a note of the unique Tender ID assigned to each tender; in case they want to obtain any clarification / help from the Helpdesk.
The bidder has to digitally sign and upload the required bid documents one by one as indicated in the tender document.
